# ubilink capability matrix

What linking works where, and by which mechanism. Unsupported app/platform
pairs degrade with an explanation in-app (U3).

| App | Platform | Mechanism |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arc | macOS | AppleScript |
| Bear | macOS | AppleScript |
| Brave Browser | macOS | AppleScript |
| Files | Linux | File path |
| Files | Windows | File path |
| Files | macOS | File path |
| Finder | macOS | AppleScript |
| Google Chrome | macOS | AppleScript |
| Microsoft Edge | macOS | AppleScript |
| Opera | macOS | AppleScript |
| Safari | macOS | AppleScript |
| Things3 | macOS | AppleScript |
| Vivaldi | macOS | AppleScript |

## Not supported

These pairs are unsupported. The app explains why when you try, and a
file-backed resource can still be linked by path.
